messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Stan 1.0.0 and RStan 1.0.0 officially released
parts:
We also probably need a branch called v1.0.x or v1.x. And a set of guidelines for what goes in what branch. And to write down our accumulated set of guidelines so that other people can find them.

One popular procedure is to commit everything to master first and then send an email to the list asking the release manager (presumably Bob) if the commit is also appropriate for stable Stan. At which point the release manager would commit it to v1.x with git cherry-pick or similar or email back that the individual should do so. But there is more than one way to skin a cat.

Ben

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Stan 1.0.0 and RStan 1.0.0 officially released
parts:
Nice.

I don't like looking at this stuff too closely in
part because all else being equal:

-- fewer lines of codes are better than more
-- fewer commits are better than more

I want to reward high-impact, low-code lines commits,
like the ones Matt or Marcus have been putting in,
not the day-to-day stuff like error checking that
consumes tons of lines, gets modified more frequently,
but isn't nearly as important.

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: debug mode in rstan
parts:
Now that users are crashing R, I think the stan() function in rstan should have a debug = FALSE argument that if TRUE would compile the model with -O0 and -g . That way we can debug it under gdb more easily.

http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/R-exts.html#Debugging-compiled-code

Ben

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] debug mode in rstan
parts:
As you know that CXXFLAGS are controlled either at R.home("etc")/Makeconf or ~/.R/Makeconf, I cannot find a way to make it configurable in R. 

What I can do is like this 
http://code.google.com/p/stan/wiki/RStanGettingStarted#Modify_C++_compiler_optimization_level

Possibly adding that if it crashes, we can change it to -O0 -g, and then debug. 

Jiqiang

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] debug mode in rstan
parts:
But only some flags can be set.  The truth is those PKG_CXXFLAGS are inserted into ALL_CXXFLAGS, which is really used for compiling the source code.  So whatever you do in PKG_CXXFLAGS for the optimization level would be overwritten by what is in CXXFLAGS in R.home('etc')/Makeconf or the Makeconf in the home directory.  But if there is no -g in CXXFLAGS, we might be able to add one if that helps. 

Jiqiang

ALL_CXXFLAGS = $(R_XTRA_CXXFLAGS) $(PKG_CXXFLAGS) $(CXXPICFLAGS) $(SHLIB_CXXFLAGS) $(CXXFLAGS)

On Sat, Sep 1, 2012 at 4:08 PM, Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:

Maybe if getPlugin("rstan") did something similar you can insert compiler options into that Makevars?
